query: What statistical sampling frame and representativeness criteria should we use to select 20–30 pilot sites for scalable national extrapolation?

response.query: What statistical sampling frame and representativeness criteria should we use to select 20–30 pilot sites for scalable national extrapolation?
response.answer: Use stratified sampling for pilot sites, ensuring diverse geographic and demographic representation. Select 20-30 sites that reflect key variables for national extrapolation. Prioritize sites with varied healthcare delivery models and patient populations.

results.title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Standards for Heavy-Duty Vehicles ...
results.content: The 2021 Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (commonly referred to as the “Bipartisan Infrastructure Law” or BIL) and the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 (“Inflation Reduction Act” or IRA) accelerate these ongoing trends by together including many incentives for the development, production, and sale of a wide range of advanced technologies (including BEVs, plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs), FCEVs, and others), electric charging infrastructure, and hydrogen, which are expected to spur significant innovation in the heavy-duty sector.[[10](#footnote-10-p29442)]  Technical assessments and data provided by commenters during the public comment period for this action's notice of proposed rulemaking (hereafter referred to as the “HD GHG Phase 3 NPRM”) as well as comments on related rules, which proposed strengthening existing MY 2027 GHG standards for heavy-duty vehicles, support that significant adoption of technologies with the greatest potential to reduce GHG emissions and associated infrastructure growth is expected to occur over the next decade.[[11 12 13 14](#footnote-11%E2%80%8912%E2%80%8913%E2%80%8914-p29442)]  We summarize  ( printed page 29443)  these developments in section B of this Executive Summary, and provide further detail in section I of the HD GHG Phase 3 NPRM, section II of this final rule, and Regulatory Impact Analysis (RIA) Chapters 1 and 2.[[15 16](#footnote-15%E2%80%8916-p29443)].

results.title: Energy & Power - Mercer Capital
results.content: Mercer Capital provides a comprehensive suite of valuation, financial reporting, transaction advisory, dispute resolution, and family business advisory services. Mercer Capital is a valuation and advisory firm. For more than forty years, we have served as a trusted and independent resource for owners, boards, management teams, fiduciaries, and professional advisors on matters such as valuing a company, evaluating a transaction, resolving a dispute, planning for succession, or assessing the financial aspects of strategic decisions. Providing a broad overview of our latest thinking relating to all aspects of business valuation and advisory services written by the professionals of Mercer Capital. From traditional oil and gas operations to emerging alternative and renewable platforms, Mercer Capital provides independent valuation and financial advisory services across the Energy sector. The energy and power sector encompasses companies involved in the production, transportation, generation, and distribution of energy across traditional and emerging sources. ##### Oil & Gas. Mercer Capital provides oil & gas companies, oil & gas servicers, and mineral & royalty owners with corporate valuation, litigation support, transaction advisory, and other related services.
